Pubbe cakkhuṃ . . . pe . . . kāyaṃ vatthuṃ anidassane khandhe aniccato . . . pe . . . domanassaṃ uppajjati; dibbāya sotadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti, cetopariyañāṇena anidassanacittasamaṃgissa cittaṃ jānāti, ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ viññāṇañcāyatanassa ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ nevasaññānāsaññāyatanassa saddāyatanaṃ sotaviññāṇassa . . . pe . . . phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa, anidassanā khandhā iddhividhañāṇassa cetopariyañāṇassa pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇassa yathākammūpagañāṇassa anāgataṃsañāṇassa āvajjanāya ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. 2.
patthana2.2:74.1: Sanidassano dhammo anidassanassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Ārammaṇādhipati:-- sanidassanaṃ rūpaṃ garuṃ katvā assādeti abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā rāgo uppajjati diṭṭhi uppajjati. 4.
patthana2.2:75.1: Anidassano dhammo anidassanassa . . . Ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati. Ārammaṇādhipati: -- dānaṃ datvā sīlaṃ uposathakammaṃ, taṃ garuṃ katvā . . . pe . . . pubbe suciṇṇāni . . . jhānā vuṭṭhahitvā . . . pe . . . Ariyā maggā vuṭṭhahitvā maggaṃ garuṃ katvā phalaṃ garuṃ katvā . . . Nibbānaṃ gotrabhussa vodānassa maggassa phalassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Cakkhuṃ . . . vatthuṃ anidassane khandhe garuṃ katvā assādeti abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati. Sahajātādhipati:-- anidassanādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ anidassanānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ ca rūpānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. 5.
patthana2.2:76.1: Anidassano dhammo sanidassanassa . . . Sahajātādhipati:-- anidassanādhipati sanidassanānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. 6.
patthana2.2:77.1: Anidassano dhammo sanidassanassa ca . . . Sahajātādhipati:-- anidassanādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ sanidassanānañ ca anidassanānañ ca cittasamuṭṭhānānañ ca rūpānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. 4.
patthana2.2:78.1: Anidassano dhammo anidassanassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo. Purimā purimā anidassanā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ anidassanānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo. Anulomaṃ gotrabhussa nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ phalasamāpattiyā anantarapaccayena paccayo. 4.
patthana2.2:79.1: Anidassano dhammo anidassanassa dhammassa samanantarapaccayena paccayo . . . sahajātāpaccayena paccayo (tīṇi) . . . aññamaññapaccayena paccayo (ekaṃ) . . . nissayapaccayena paccayo (tīṇi). 2.
patthana2.2:80.1: Sanidassano dhammo anidassanassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo. Ārammanūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo . . . Pakatūpanissayo, vaṇṇasampadaṃ patthayamāno dānaṃ sīlaṃ uposathakammaṃ karoti; vaṇṇasampadā saddhāya . . . pe . . . patthanāya kāyikassa sukhassa kāyikassa dukkhassa maggassa phalasamāpattiyā upanissayapaccayena paccayo. 4.
patthana2.2:81.1: Anidassano dhammo anidassanassa . . . Ārammaṇūpanissayo . . . pe . . . Pakatūpanissayo:-- saddhaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ deti . . . pe . . . samāpattiṃ uppādeti mānaṃ jappeti diṭṭhiṃ gaṇhāti; sīlaṃ . . . pe . . . senāsanaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ deti . . . pe . . . saṃghaṃ bhindati; saddhā . . . pe . . . senāsanaṃ saddhāya . . . pe . . . phalasamāpattiyā upanissayapaccayena paccayo. 2.
patthana2.2:82.1: Sanidassano dhammo anidassanassa dhammassa purejātapaccayena paccayo. Sanidassane rūpe aniccato . . . pe . . . domanassaṃ uppajjati; dibbena cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati; rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa purejātapaccayena paccayo. 4.
patthana2.2:83.1: Anidassano dhammo anidassanassa dhammassa purejātapaccayena paccayo. Ārammaṇapurejātaṃ, vatthupurejātaṃ. Ārammaṇapurejātaṃ cakkhuṃ . . . pe . . . vatthuṃ aniccato . . . pe . . . domanassaṃ uppajjati; dibbāya sotadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti; saddāyatanaṃ sotaviññāṇassa . . . phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa purejātapaccayena paccayo. Vatthupurejātaṃ cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa . . . kāyāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa vatthu anidassanānaṃ khandhānaṃ purejātapaccayena paccayo. 8.
patthana2.2:84.1: Sanidassano ca anidassano ca dhammā anidassanassa dhammassa purejātapaccayena paccayo. Ārammaṇapurejātaṃ:-- rūpāyatanañ ca vatthu ca anidassanānaṃ khandhānaṃ purejātapaccayena paccayo; rūpāyatanañ ca cakkhāyatanañ ca cakkhuviññāṇassa purejātapaccayena paccayo. 4.
patthana2.2:85.1: Anidassano dhammo anidassanassa dhammassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā anidassanā khandhā purejātassa imassa anidassanassa kāyassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo. 5.
patthana2.2:86.1: Anidassano dhammo sanidassanassa . . . Pacchājātā . . . imassa sanidassanassa kāyassa . . . 6.
patthana2.2:87.1: Anidassano dhammo sanidassanassa ca . . . Pacchājātā anidassanā khandhā purejātassa imassa sanidassanassa ca anidassanassa ca kāyassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo. 4.
patthana2.2:88.1: Anidassano dhammo anidassanassa dhammassa āsevanapaccayena paccayo. Purimā purimā . . . pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ . . . pe . . . . . .
patthana2.2:89.1: kammapaccayena paccayo. Sahajātā, nānākhaṇikā. Sahājātā anidassanā cetanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ anidassanānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ ca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. Nānākhaṇikā anidassanā cetanā vipākānaṃ anidassanānaṃ khandhānaṃ anidassanānañ ca kaṭattā rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. 5.
patthana2.2:91.1: Anidassano dhammo sanidassanassa ca anidassanassa ca dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo. Sahajātā, nānākhaṇikā . . . (vitthāretabbaṃ). 4.
patthana2.2:92.1: Anidassano dhammo anidassanassa dhammassa vipākapaccayena paccayo . . . (tīṇi) . . . āhārapaccayena paccayo . . . (tīṇi, tīsu pi kabaḷiṃkāro āhāro kātabbo) . . . indriyapaccayena paccayo . . . (tīṇi, tisū pi rūpajīvitindriyaṃ) . . . jhānapaccayena paccayo . . . (tīṇi) . . . maggapaccayena paccayo . . . (tīṇi) . . . sampayuttapaccayena paccayo . . . (ekaṃ). 4.
patthana2.2:93.1: Anidassano dhammo anidassanassa dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ. Sahajātā anidassanā khandhā anidassanānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe anidassanā khandhā anidassanānaṃ kaṭattā rūpānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Khandhā vatthussa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo, vatthu khandhānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Purejātaṃ:-- cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa . . . kāyāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa, vatthu anidassanānaṃ khandhānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā anidassanā khandhā purejātassa imassa anidassanassa kāyassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. 5.
patthana2.2:94.1: Anidassano dhammo sanidassanassa dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ. Sahajātā anidassanā khandhā sanidassanānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe pacchājātā anidassanā khandhā purejātassa imassa sanidassanassa kāyassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. 6.
patthana2.2:95.1: Anidassano dhammo sanidassanassa ca . . . Sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ. Sahājātā anidassanā khandhā sanidassanānañ ca anidassanānañ ca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe pacchājātā anidassanā khandhā purejātassa imassa sanidassanassa ca anidassanassa ca kāyassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. 2.
patthana2.2:96.1: Sanidassano dhammo anidassanassa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo. Sanidassane rūpe aniccato . . . pe . . . domanassaṃ uppajjati; dibbena cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati; rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa atthipaccayena paccayo. 4.
patthana2.2:97.1: Anidassano dhammo anidassanassa . . . Sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ āhāraṃ indriyaṃ. Sahajāto anidassano eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ anidassanānañ ca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. Dve . . . (saṃkhittaṃ, yāva asaññasattā). Purejātaṃ cakkhuṃ . . . pe . . . vatthuṃ aniccato . . . pe . . . domanassaṃ uppajjati; dibbāya sotadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti, saddāyatanaṃ sotaviññāṇassa . . . phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa; cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa . . . kāyāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa, vatthu anidassanānaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā anidassanā khandhā purejātassa imassa anidassanassa kāyassa atthipaccayena paccayo. Kabaḷiṃkāro āhāro imassa anidassanassa kāyassa atthipaccayena paccayo. Rūpajīvitindriyaṃ anidassanānaṃ kaṭattā rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. 5.
patthana2.2:98.1: Anidassano dhammo sanidassanassa . . . Sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ āhāraṃ indriyaṃ. Sahajātā anidassanā khandhā sanidassanānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe mahābhūtā sanidassanānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ kaṭaṭṭā rūpānaṃ upādā rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. Bāhiraṃ āhārasamuṭṭhānaṃ utusamuṭṭhānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ mahābhūtā sanidassanassa . . . Pacchājātā anidassanā khandhā purejātassa imassa sanidassanassa kāyassa atthipaccayena paccayo. Kabaḷiṃkāro āhāro imassa sanidassanassa kāyassa atthipaccayena paccayo. Rūpajīvitindriyaṃ sanidassanānaṃ kaṭattā rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. 6.
patthana2.2:99.1: Anidassano dhammo sanidassanassa ca . . . Sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ āhāraṃ indriyaṃ. Sahajāto anidassano eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ sanidassanānañ ca anidassanānañ ca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo; dve khandhā . . . Paṭisandhikkhaṇe mahābhūtā sanidassanānañ ca anidassanānañ ca cittasamuṭṭhānānañ . . . Bāhiraṃ mahābhūtā sanidassanānañ ca anidassanānañ ca kaṭattā-rūpānaṃ upādā-rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. 8.
patthana2.2:100.1: Sanidassano ca . . . anidassanassa . . . Purejātaṃ rūpāyatanañ ca vatthu ca anidassanānaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. Rūpāyatanañ ca cakkhāyatanañ ca cakkhuviññāṇassa atthipaccayena paccayo . . .
patthana2.2:102.1: Hetuyā tīṇi, Kamme tīṇi, ārammaṇe dve, vipāke tīṇi, adhipatiyā cattāri, āhāre tīṇi, anantare ekaṃ, indriye tīṇi, samanantare ekaṃ, jhāne tīṇi, sahajāte tīṇi, magge tīṇi, aññamaññe ekaṃ, sampayutte ekaṃ, nissaye tīṇi, vippayutte tīṇi, upanissaye dve, atthiyā pañca, purejāte tīṇi, natthiyā ekaṃ, pacchājāte tīṇi, vigate ekaṃ, āsevane ekaṃ, avigate pañca:-- evaṃ gaṇetabbaṃ.
patthana2.2:104.1: Sanidassano dhammo sanidassanassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo . . . upanissayapaccayena paccayo . . . 4.
patthana2.2:105.1: Anidassano dhammo anidassanassa dhammassa ārammaṇa-, sahajāta-, upanissaya-, purejāta-, pacchājāta-, kamma-, āhāra-, indriyapaccayena paccayo. 5.
patthana2.2:106.1: Anidassano dhammo sanidassanassa dhammassa sahajāta-, pacchājāta-, kamma-, āhāra-, indriyapaccayena paccayo. 6.
patthana2.2:107.1: Anidassano dhammo sanidassanassa ca anidassanassa ca dhammassa . . . 9.
patthana2.2:108.1: Sanidassano ca . . . sanidassanassa ca . . . purejātapaccayena paccayo.
patthana2.2:109.1: Nahetuyā pañca, napurejāte cattāri, nārammaṇe cattāri, napacchājāte pañca, nādhipatiyā pañca, sabbattha pañca; nānantare pañca, nasampayutte pañca, nasamanantare pañca, navippayutte cattāri, nasahajāte pañca, no-atthiyā cattāri, na-aññamaññe pañca, nonatthiyā pañca, nanissaye cattāri, novigate pañca, na-upanissaye pañca, no-avigate cattāri.
patthana2.2:111.1: Hetupaccayā, nārammaṇe na-upanissaye tīṇi, . . . tīṇi, (saṃkhittaṃ), nādhipatiyā tīṇi, nasampayutte tīṇi, nānantare tīṇi, navippayutte ekaṃ, nasamanantare tīṇi, nonatthiyā tīṇi, na-aññamaññe tīṇi, novigate tīṇi.
patthana2.2:113.1: Nahetupaccayā, ārammaṇe āsevane ekaṃ, dve, kamme tīṇi . . . patthana2.2:115.1: Sappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca sappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Sappaṭighaṃ ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ paṭicca dve mahābhūtā; dve mahābhūte . . . ekaṃ . . . patthana2.2:116.1: Sappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca appaṭigho . . . Sappaṭighe mahābhūte paṭicca āpodhātu. Sappaṭighe mahābhūte paṭicca appaṭighaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ kaṭattā rūpaṃ upādā rūpaṃ. Phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ paṭicca āpodhātu itthindriyaṃ . . . kabaḷiṃkāro āhāro. 3.
patthana2.2:117.1: Sappaṭighaṃ . . . sappaṭigho ca appaṭigho ca . . . Sappaṭighaṃ ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ paṭicca dve mahābhūtā āpodhātu ca; dve mahābhūte . . . pe . . . Sappaṭighe mahabhūte paṭicca sappaṭighañ ca appaṭighañ ca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ kaṭattā rūpaṃ upādā rūpaṃ. Phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ paṭicca cakkhāyatanaṃ rasāyatanaṃ apodhātu itthindriyaṃ . . . kabaḷiṃkāro āhāro. 4.
patthana2.2:118.1: Appaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca appaṭigho . . . Appaṭighaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo kahandhā appaṭighaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānañ ca rūpaṃ; dve . . . pe . . . Paṭisandhikkhaṇe khandhe paṭicca vatthu, vatthuṃ paṭicca khandhā. Āpodhātuṃ paṭicca appaṭighaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ kaṭattā rūpaṃ upādā rūpaṃ. Āpodhātuṃ paṭicca itthindriyaṃ . . . kabaḷiṃkāro āhāro. 5.
patthana2.2:119.1: Appaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca sappaṭigho . . . Appaṭighe khandhe paṭicca sappaṭighaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe āpodhātuṃ paṭicca sappaṭighā mahābhūtā; āpodhātuṃ paṭicca sappaṭighaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ kaṭattā rūpaṃ upādā rūpaṃ; āpodhātuṃ paṭicca cakkhāyatanaṃ phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ. 6.
patthana2.2:120.1: Appaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca sappaṭigho ca appaṭigho ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā. Appaṭighaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā, sappaṭighañ ca appaṭighañ ca cittasamuṭṭhānañ ca rūpaṃ; dve . . . pe . . . Paṭisandhikkhaṇe āpodhātuṃ paṭicca sappaṭighañ ca appatighañ ca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ kaṭattā rūpaṃ upādā rūpaṃ. Āpodhātuṃ paṭicca cakkhāyatanaṃ phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ itthindriyaṃ . . . kabaḷiṃkāro āhāro. 7.
patthana2.2:121.1: Sappaṭighañ ca . . . sappaṭigho dhammo . . . Appaṭighe khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paṭicca sappaṭighaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe sappaṭighaṃ ekaṃ mahābhūtañ ca āpodhātuñ ca paṭicca dve mahābhūtā; sappaṭighe mahābhūte ca āpodhātuñ ca paṭicca sappaṭighaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ kaṭattā rūpaṃ upādā rūpaṃ. Phoṭṭhabbāyatanañ ca āpodhātuñ ca paṭicca cakkhāyatanaṃ rasāyatanaṃ. 8.
patthana2.2:122.1: Sappaṭighañ ca . . . appaṭigho dhammo . . . Appaṭighe khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paṭicca appaṭighaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe appaṭighe khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paṭicca appaṭighaṃ kaṭattā rūpaṃ. Phoṭṭhabbāyatanañ ca āpodhātuñ ca paṭicca appaṭighaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ kaṭattā rūpaṃ upādā rūpaṃ. Phoṭṭhabbāyatanañ ca āpodhātuñ ca paṭicca itthindriyaṃ . . . kabaḷiṃkāro āhāro. 9.
patthana2.2:123.1: Sappaṭighañ ca . . . sappaṭigho ca . . . Appaṭighe khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paṭicca sappaṭighañ ca appatighañ ca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe appaṭighe khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paṭicca kaṭattā rūpaṃ. Phoṭṭhabbāyatanañ ca āpodhātuñ ca paṭicca sappaṭighañ ca appaṭighañ ca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ kaṭattā rūpaṃ upādā rūpaṃ. patthana2.2:124.1: Appaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca sappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā. Appaṭighaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā . . . pe . . . dve . . . pe . . . Paṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthuṃ paṭicca khandhā. 2.
patthana2.2:125.1: Sappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca appaṭigho dhammo uppajjati adhipatipaccayā . . . patthana2.2:126.1: Sappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca appaṭigho dhammo uppajjati aññamaññapaccayā. Sappaṭighe mahābhūte paṭicca āpodhātu. 3.
patthana2.2:127.1: Sappaṭighaṃ . . . sappaṭigho ca . . . Sappaṭighaṃ ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ paṭicca dve mahābhūtā ca āpodhātu ca; dve . . . pe . . . 4.
patthana2.2:128.1: Appaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca appaṭigho . . . Appaṭighaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā; dve . . . pe . . . Paṭisandhikkhaṇe khandhe paṭicca vatthu, vatthuṃ paṭicca khandhā. 5.
patthana2.2:129.1: Appaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca sappaṭigho . . . Apodhātuṃ paṭicca sappaṭighā mahābhūtā . . . (ime ajjhatikā bāhirā mahābhūtā kātabbā). 7.
patthana2.2:130.1: Sappaṭighañ ca appaṭighañ ca dhammaṃ paṭicca sappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati aññamaññapaccayā. Sappaṭighaṃ ekaṃ mahābhūtañ ca āpodhātuñ ca paṭicca dve mahābhūtā . . . nissayapaccayā . . . avigatapaccayā . . .
patthana2.2:131.1: Hetuyā nava, vipāke nava, ārammaṇe ekaṃ, āhāre nava, adhipatiyā nava, indriye nava, anantare ekaṃ, jhāne nava, samanantare ekaṃ, magge nava, sahajāte nava, sampayutte ekaṃ, aññamaññe cha, vippayutte nava, nissaye nava, atthiyā nava, upanissaye ekaṃ, natthiyā ekaṃ, purejāte ekaṃ, vigate ekaṃ, āsevane ekaṃ, avigate nava. kamme nava,
patthana2.2:133.1: Sappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca sappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā . . . (tīṇi). 4.
patthana2.2:134.1: Appaṭighaṃ . . . appaṭigho . . . nahetupaccayā. Ahetukaṃ appaṭighaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā appaṭighaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānañ ca rūpaṃ; dve . . . pe . . . Ahetukapaṭisandhikkhaṇe khandhe paṭicca vatthu, vatthuṃ paṭicca khandhā; āpodhātuṃ paṭicca appaṭighaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ kaṭattā rūpaṃ upādā rūpaṃ; āpodhātuṃ paṭicca itthindriyaṃ . . . kabaḷiṃkāro āhāro. patthana2.2:135.1: (Appaṭighamūlakaṃ itare pi dve pañhā kātabbā; ghaṭane pi tīṇi pañhā kātabbā; ajjhattikā bāhirā mahābhūtā sabbe jānitvā kātabbā.) 1.
patthana2.2:136.1: Sappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca sappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati nārammaṇapaccayā . . . (sabbaṃ saṃkhittaṃ) . . . novigatapaccayā.
patthana2.2:137.1: Nahetuyā nava, nakamme nava, narammaṇe nava, navipāke nava, nādhipatiyā nava, nāhāre nava, nānantare nava, na-indriye nava, nasamanantare nava, najhāne nava, na-aññamaññe nava, namagge nava, na-upanissaye nava, nasampayutte nava, napurejāte nava, navippayutte nava, napacchājāte nava, nonatthiyā nava, nāsevane nava, novigate nava.
patthana2.2:139.1: Hetupaccayā, nārammaṇe napacchājāte nava, nava, nāsevane nava, nādhipatiyā nava, nakamme ekaṃ, nānantare nava, navipāke nava, nasamanantare nava, nasampayutte nava, na-aññamaññe nava, navippayutte ekaṃ, na-upanissaye nava, nonatthiyā nava, napurejāte nava, novigate nava.
patthana2.2:141.1: Nahetupaccayā, ārammaṇe sahajāte nava, ekaṃ, aññamaññe cha, anantare ekaṃ, nissaye nava, samanantare ekaṃ, upanissaye ekaṃ, Purejāte ekaṃ, vippayutte nava, āsevane ekaṃ, atthiyā nava, kamme nava . . . natthiyā ekaṃ, (saṃkhittaṃ) . . . vigate ekaṃ, magge ekaṃ, avigate nava.
patthana2.2:144.1: Sappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā sappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā . . . (tīṇi). 4.
patthana2.2:145.1: Appaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā appaṭigho . . . Appaṭighaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paccayā tayo khandhā appaṭighaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānañ ca rūpaṃ; dve . . . pe . . . patthana2.2:147.1: Sappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā appaṭigho dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā. Cakkhāyatanaṃ paccayā cakkhuviññāṇaṃ . . . kāyāyatanaṃ paccayā kāyaviññāṇaṃ. 4.
patthana2.2:148.1: Appaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā appaṭigho . . . Appaṭighaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paccayā tayo khandhā; dve . . . pe . . . Paṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthuṃ paccayā appaṭighā khandhā. 8.
patthana2.2:149.1: Sappaṭighañ ca appaṭighañ ca . . . appaṭigho . . . Cakkhuviññāṇasahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhañ ca cakkhāyatanañ ca paccayā tayo khandhā . . . kāyaviññāṇasahagataṃ ekaṃ khandhañ ca kāyāyatanañ ca paccayā tayo khandhā . . . adhipatigaccayā . . . (saṃkhittaṃ) . . . avigatapaccayā . . .
patthana2.2:150.1: Hetuyā nava, nissaye nava, ārammaṇe tīṇi, upanissaye tīṇi, adhipatiyā nava, purejāte tīṇi, anantare tīṇi, āsevane ekaṃ, samanantare tīṇi, kamme nava, sahajāte nava, avigate nava. aññamaññe cha, (Evaṃ paccaniyagaṇanā pi kātabbā.
patthana2.2:152.1: sabbattha ekā yeva pañhā. Dve pi vārā kātabbā.) 4.
patthana2.2:153.1: Appaṭigho dhammo appaṭighassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo. Appaṭighā hetū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ appaṭighānañ ca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo . . . (paṭisandhi). 5.
patthana2.2:154.1: Appaṭigho dhammo sappaṭighassa . . . Appaṭighā hetū sappaṭighānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo . . . (paṭisandhi). 6.
patthana2.2:155.1: Appaṭigho dhammo sappaṭighassa ca . . . Appaṭighā hetū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ sappaṭighānañ ca appaṭighānañ ca cittasamuṭṭhānānañ ca rūpānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo. . . . (paṭisandhi). 2.
patthana2.2:156.1: Sappaṭigho dhammo appaṭighassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. Rūpe . . . pe . . . phoṭṭhabbe aniccato . . . pe . . . domanassaṃ uppajjati; dibbena cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, dibbāya sotadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti. Rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa . . . phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa sappaṭighā khandhā iddhividhañāṇassa pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇassa yathākammūpagañāṇassa anāgataṃsañāṇassa āvajjanāya ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. 4.
patthana2.2:157.1: Appaṭigho dhammo appatighassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. Dānaṃ sīlaṃ uposathakammaṃ katvā taṃ paccavekkhati, pubbe suciṇṇāni paccavekkhati, jhānā vuṭṭhahitvā jhānaṃ paccavekkhati. Ariyā maggā vuṭṭhahitvā maggaṃ paccavekkhanti, phalaṃ paccavekkhanti. Nibbānaṃ gotrabhussa vodānassa maggassa phalassa āvajjanāya ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. Ariyā pahīnakilese paccavekkhanti, vikkhambhitakilese paccavekkhanti, pubbe samudāciṇṇe kilese jānanti. Vatthuṃ itthindriyaṃ purisindriyaṃ jīvitindriyaṃ āpodhātuṃ kabaḷiṃkāraṃ āhāraṃ aniccato . . . pe . . . domanassaṃ uppajjati, cetopariyañāṇena appaṭighacittasamaṃgissa cittaṃ jānāti; ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ viññāṇañcāyatanassa, ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ nevasaññānāsaññāyatanassa, appaṭighā khandhā iddhividhañāṇassa cetopariyañāṇassa pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇassa yathākammūpagañāṇassa anāgataṃsañāṇassa āvajjanāya ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. 2.
patthana2.2:158.1: Sappaṭigho dhammo appaṭighassa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Ārammaṇādhipati:-- cakkhuṃ phoṭṭhabbe garuṃ katvā assādeti abhinandati . . . (saṃkhittaṃ) . . . taṃ garuṃ katvā rāgo uppajjati diṭṭhi uppajjati. 4.
patthana2.2:159.1: Appaṭigho dhammo appaṭighassa . . . Ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati. Ārammaṇādhipati: -- dānaṃ sīlaṃ uposathakammaṃ taṃ garuṃ katvā pubbe suciṇṇāni . . . jhānā vuṭṭhahitvā jhānaṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhati. Ariyā maggā vuṭṭhahitvā maggaṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhanti, phalaṃ garuṃ katvā . . . Nibbānaṃ gotrabhussa vodānassa maggassa phalassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Vatthuṃ itthindriyaṃ purisindriyaṃ jīvitindriyaṃ āpodhātuṃ kabaḷiṃkāraṃ āhāraṃ garuṃ katvā assādeti abhinandati taṃ garuṃ katvā rāgo uppajjati diṭṭhi uppajjati. Sahajātādhipati:-- appaṭighādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ appaṭighānañ ca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ adhipaṭipaccayena paccayo. 5.
patthana2.2:160.1: Appaṭigho dhammo sappaṭighassa . . . Sahajātādhipati:-- appaṭighādhipati sappaṭighānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ . . . 6.
patthana2.2:161.1: Appaṭigho dhammo sappaṭighassa ca . . . Sahajātādhipati:-- appaṭighādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ sappaṭighānañ ca appaṭighānañ ca cittasamuṭṭhānānañ ca rūpānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. 4.
patthana2.2:162.1: Appaṭigho dhammo appaṭighassa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo. Purimā purimā appaṭighā . . . pe . . . phalasamāpattiyā anantarapaccayena paccayo. 4.
patthana2.2:163.1: Appaṭigho dhammo appaṭighassa dhammassa samanantarapaccayena paccayo.
patthana2.2:164.1: Sappaṭigho dhammo sappaṭighassa dhammassa sahajātapaccayena paccayo . . . (nava) . . . aññamaññapaccayena paccayo . . . (cha) . . . nissayapaccayena paccayo . . . (nava). 2.
patthana2.2:165.1: Sappaṭigho dhammo appaṭighassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo. Ārammaṇūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo . . . pe . . . Pakaṭūpanissayo:-- utuṃ . . . pe . . . senāsanaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ deti . . . pe . . . saṃghaṃ bhindati, utu . . . pe . . . senāsanaṃ saddhāya . . . pe . . . phalasamāpattiyā upanissayapaccayena paccayo. 4.
patthana2.2:166.1: Appaṭigho dhammo appaṭighassa . . . Ārammaṇūpanissayo . . . pe . . . pakatūpanissayo:-- saddhaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ deti . . . pe . . . diṭṭhiṃ gaṇhāti. Sīlaṃ . . . pe . . . kāyikaṃ sukhaṃ kāyikaṃ dukkhaṃ bhojanaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ deti . . . pe . . . saṃghaṃ bhindati. Saddhā . . . pe . . . bhojanaṃ saddhāya . . . pe . . . phalasamāpattiyā upanissayapaccayena paccayo. 2.
patthana2.2:167.1: Sappaṭigho dhammo appaṭighassa dhammassa purejātapaccayena paccayo. Ārammaṇapurejātaṃ, vatthupurejātaṃ. Ārammaṇapurejātaṃ:-- cakkhuṃ . . . pe . . . phoṭṭhabbe aniccato . . . pe . . . domanassaṃ uppajjati, dibbena cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, dibbāya sotadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti; rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa, . . . phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa purejātapaccayena paccayo. Vatthupurejātaṃ:-- cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa . . . kāyāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa purejātapaccayena paccayo. 4.
patthana2.2:168.1: Appaṭigho dhammo appaṭighassa . . . Ārammaṇapurejātanaṃ, vatthupurejātaṃ. Ārammaṇapurejātaṃ:-- vatthuṃ itthindriyaṃ purisindriyaṃ jivitindriyaṃ āpodhātuṃ kabaḷiṃkāraṃ āhāraṃ aniccato . . . pe . . . domanassaṃ uppajjati. Vatthupurejātaṃ:-- vatthu appaṭighānaṃ khandhānaṃ purejātapaccayena paccayo. 8.
patthana2.2:169.1: Sappaṭigho ca . . . dhammā appaṭighassa . . . Ārammaṇapurejātaṃ cakkhāyatanañ ca vatthu ca . . . phoṭṭhabbāyatanañ ca vatthu ca . . . appaṭighānaṃ khandhānaṃ purejātapaccayena paccayo. 4.
patthana2.2:170.1: Appaṭigho dhammo appaṭighassa dhammassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā appaṭighā khandhā purejātassa imassa appaṭighassa kāyassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā appaṭighā khandhā purejātassa imassa sappaṭighassa kāyassa, pacchājātā appaṭighā khandhā purejātassa imassa sappaṭighassa ca appaṭighassa ca kāyassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo. (Dvinnam pi mūlā kātabbā.) 4.
patthana2.2:171.1: Appaṭigho dhammo appaṭighassa dhammassa āsevanapaccayena paccayo. Purimā purimā appaṭighā . . . pe . . . vodānassa maggassa āsevanapaccayena paccayo. 4.
patthana2.2:172.1: Appaṭigho dhammo appaṭighassa dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo. Sahajātā, nānākhaṇikā. Sahajātā appaṭighā cetanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ appaṭighānañ ca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. Nānākhaṇikā appaṭighā cetanā vipākānaṃ khandhānaṃ appaṭighānañ ca kaṭattā rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. 5.
patthana2.2:173.1: Appaṭigho dhammo sappaṭighassa . . . Sahajātā, nānākhaṇikā . . . khandhānaṃ sappaṭighānañ ca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. Nānākhaṇikā . . . khandhānaṃ sappaṭighānañ ca kaṭattā rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. 6.
patthana2.2:174.1: Appaṭigho dhammo sappaṭighassa ca . . . Sahajātā, nānākhaṇikā . . . pe . . . 4.
patthana2.2:175.1: Appaṭigho dhammo appaṭighassa dhammassa vipākapaccayena paccayo . . . (vipāko appaṭigho tīṇi). 4.
patthana2.2:176.1: Appaṭigho dhammo appaṭighassa dhammassa āhārapaccayena paccayo. Appaṭighā āhārā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ appaṭighānañ ca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ āhārapaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe kabaḷiṃkāro āhāro imassa appaṭighassa kāyassa āhārapaccayena paccayo. (Avasesā dve pi pañhā kātabbā. Paṭisandhi kabaḷiṃkāro āhāro dvīsu pi kātabbā agge.) 2.
patthana2.2:177.1: Sappaṭigho dhammo appaṭighassa dhammassa indriyapaccayena paccayo. Cakkhundriyaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa . . . kāyindriyaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa indriyapaccayena paccayo. 4.
patthana2.2:178.1: Appaṭigho dhammo appaṭighassa . . . (tīṇi, tisu ca jīvitindriyaṃ agge kātabbaṃ). 8.
patthana2.2:179.1: Sappaṭigho ca . . . dhammā appaṭighassa . . . Cakkhundriyañ ca cakkhuviññāṇañ ca cakkhuviññāṇasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ indriyapaccayena paccayo. Kāyindriyañ ca kāyaviññāṇañ ca kāyaviññāṇasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ indriyapaccayena paccayo . . . jhānapaccayena paccayo . . . (tīṇi) . . . maggapaccayena paccayo . . . (tīṇi) . . . sampayuttapaccayena paccayo . . . (ekaṃ). 2.
patthana2.2:180.1: Sappaṭigho dhammo appaṭighassa dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Purejātaṃ cakkhāyatanañ ca cakkhuviññāṇassa . . . kāyāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa vippayuttappaccayena paccayo. 4.
patthana2.2:181.1: Appaṭigho dhammo appaṭighassa . . . Sahajātanaṃ, purejātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ. Sahājātā appaṭighā khandhā appaṭighānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo . . . phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. Rūpino khandhā iddhividhañāṇassa . . . pe . . . anāgataṃsañāṇassa āvajjanāya ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. 4.
patthana2.2:260.1: Arūpī dhammo arūpissa dhammassa . . . Dānaṃ, sīlaṃ, uposathakammaṃ taṃ paccavekkhati, pubbe jhānā . . . Ariyā maggā . . . phalaṃ paccavekkhanti. Nibbānaṃ gotrabhussa vodānassa maggassa phalassa āvajjanāya ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. Ariyā pahīnakilese . . . (saṃkhittaṃ) . . . vikkhambhitakilese. . . pubbe . . . Arūpino khandhe aniccato . . . pe . . . domanassaṃ uppajjati; cetopariyañāṇena arūpicittasamaṃgissa cittaṃ jānāti, ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ viññāṇañcāyatanassa ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ nevasaññānāsaññāyatanassa arūpino khandhā iddhividhañāṇassa cetopariyañāṇassa pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇassa yathākammūpagañāṇassa anāgataṃsañāṇassa āvajjanāya ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. 2.
patthana2.2:261.1: Rūpī dhammo arūpissa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Ārammaṇādhipati:-- cakkhuṃ . . . pe . . . kabaḷiṃkāraṃ āhāraṃ garuṃ katvā assādeti abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā rāgo uppajjati diṭṭhi uppajjati. 4.
patthana2.2:262.1: Arūpī dhammo arūpissa dhammassa . . . Ārammaṇādhipati, sahajātādhipati. Ārammaṇādhipati:-- dānaṃ . . . (saṃkhittaṃ) . . . nibbānaṃ maggassa phalassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Arūpino khandhe garuṃ katvā assādeti . . . rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati. Sahajātādhipāti:-- arūpī adhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. 5.
patthana2.2:263.1: Arūpī dhammo rūpissa dhammassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Sahajātādhipati:-- arūpī adhipati cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. 6.
patthana2.2:264.1: Arūpī dhammo rūpissa . . . ca arūpissa . . . Sahajātādhipati:-- arūpī adhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ ca rūpānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. 4.
patthana2.2:265.1: Arūpī dhammo arūpissa dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo. Purimā purimā arūpino khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ arūpīnaṃ khandhānaṃ phalasamāpattiyā anantarapaccayena paccayo . . . samanantarapaccayena paccayo . . .
patthana2.2:266.1: sahajātapaccayena paccayo . . . (satta, miha ghaṭanā natthi) . . . aññamaññapaccayena paccayo . . . nissayapaccayena paccayo . . . (satta pañhā, miha ghaṭanā natthi). 2.
patthana2.2:267.1: Rūpī dhammo arūpissa upanissayapaccayena paccayo. Ārammaṇūpanissayo pakatūpanissayo . . . pe . . . Pakatūpanissayo:-- utu bhojanaṃ senāsanaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ deti . . . pe . . . saṃghaṃ bhindati. Utu bhojanaṃ senāsanaṃ saddhāya . . . pe . . . phalasamāpattiyā upanissayapaccayena paccayo. 4.
patthana2.2:268.1: Arūpī dhammo arūpissa dhammassa upannissayapaccayena paccayo. Ārammaṇūpanissayo . . .1pe . . . Pakatūpanissayo:-- saddhaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ deti . . . pe . . . sīlaṃ . . . kāyikaṃ dukkhaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ deti . . . pe . . . saṃghaṃ bhindati; saddhā . . . pe . . . kāyikaṃ dukkhaṃ saddhāya . . . pe . . . phalasamāpattiyā upanissayapaccayena paccayo. 2.
patthana2.2:269.1: Rūpī dhammo arūpissa dhammassa purejātapaccayena paccayo. Ārammaṇapurejātaṃ, vatthupurejātaṃ. Ārammaṇapurejātaṃ:-- cakkhuṃ . . . pe . . . vatthuṃ kabaḷiṃkāraṃ āhāraṃ aniccato . . . pe . . . domanassaṃ uppajjati; dibbena cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, dibbāya sotadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti; rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa . . . phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa. . . . Vatthupurejātaṃ:-- cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa . . . kāyāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa vatthu arūpīnaṃ dhammānaṃ purejātapaccayena paccayo. 5.
patthana2.2:270.1: Arūpī dhammo rūpissa dhammassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā arūpino khandhā purejātassa imassa kāyassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo. 4.
patthana2.2:271.1: Arūpī dhammo arūpissa dhammassa āsevanapaccayena paccayo. Purimā purimā . . . pe . . . pacchimānaṃ . . . 4.
patthana2.2:272.1: Arūpī dhammo arūpissa dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo. Sahajātā, nānākhaṇikā. Sahajātā arūpī cetanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. Nānākhaṇikā arūpī cetanā vipākānaṃ khandhānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. 5.
patthana2.2:273.1: Arūpī dhammo rūpissa dhammassa . . . Sahajātā, nānākhaṇikā. Sahājātā arūpī cetanā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. Nānākhaṇikā arūpī cetanā kaṭattā rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. 6.
patthana2.2:274.1: Arūpī dhammo rūpissa ca arūpissa . . . Sahajātā, nānākhaṇikā. Sahajātā arūpī cetanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ ca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. Nānākhaṇikā arūpī cetanā vipākānaṃ khandhānaṃ kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. 4.
patthana2.2:275.1: Arūpī dhammo arūpissa dhammassa vipākapaccayena paccayo . . . (tīṇi). 1.
patthana2.2:276.1: Rūpī dhammo rūpissa dhammassa āhārapaccayena paccayo. Kabaḷiṃkāro āhāro imassa kāyassa āhārapaccayena paccayo. 4.
patthana2.2:277.1: Arūpī dhammo arūpissa dhammassa āhārapaccayena paccayo . . . (tīṇi). 1.
patthana2.2:278.1: Rūpī dhammo rūpissa dhammassa indriyapaccayena paccayo. Rūpajīvitindriyaṃ kaṭattā rūpānaṃ indriyapaccayena paccayo. 2.
patthana2.2:279.1: Rūpī dhammo arūpissa dhammassa . . . Cakkhundriyaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa . . . kāyindriyaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa indriyapaccayena paccayo. 4.
patthana2.2:280.1: Arūpī dhammo arūpissa dhammassa indriyapaccayena paccayo . . . (tīṇi). 8.
patthana2.2:281.1: Rūpī ca arūpī ca . . . arūpissa . . . Cakkhundriyañ ca cakkhuviññāṇañ ca cakkhuviññāṇasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ indriyapaccayena paccayo. Kāyindriyañ ca . . . pe . . . 4.
patthana2.2:282.1: Arūpī dhammo arūpissa dhammassa jhānapaccayena paccayo . . . (tīṇi) . . . maggapaccayena paccayo . . . (tīṇi) . . . sampayuttapaccayena paccayo . . . (ekaṃ). 2.
patthana2.2:283.1: Rūpī dhammo arūpissa dhammassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ. Sahajātaṃ:-- paṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthu arūpīnaṃ khandhānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Purejātaṃ cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa . . . kāyāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa, vatthu arūpīnaṃ khandhānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. 5.
patthana2.2:284.1: Arūpī dhammo rūpissa dhammassa . . . Sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ. Sahajātā arūpino khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe arūpī khandhā kaṭattā rūpānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā arūpino khandhā purejātassa imassa kāyassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. 1.
patthana2.2:285.1: Rūpī dhammo rūpissa dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo. Sahājātaṃ āhāraṃ indriyaṃ. Sahajātaṃ ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ . . . (yāva asaññasattā). Kabaḷiṃkāro āhāro imassa kāyassa atthiyapaccayena paccayo. Rūpajīvitindriyaṃ kaṭattā rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. 2.
patthana2.2:286.1: Rūpī dhammo arūpissa dhammassa . . . Sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ. Sahajātaṃ:-- paṭisandhikkhaṇe vatthu arūpīnaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. Purejātaṃ:-- cakkhuṃ . . . pe . . . kabaḷiṃkāraṃ āhāraṃ aniccato . . . pe . . . domanassaṃ uppajjati; dibbena cakkhunā.. pe . . . dibbāya sotadhātuyā . . . pe . . . rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa . . . phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa, cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa . . . kāyāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa, vatthu arūpīnaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. 4.
patthana2.2:287.1: Arūpī dhammo arūpissa dhammassa . . . Arūpī eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ . . . pe . . . dve . . . pe . . . Paṭisandhikkhaṇe . . . pe . . . 5.
patthana2.2:288.1: Arūpī dhammo rūpissa dhammassa . . . Sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ. Sahajātā arūpino khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe pacchājātā arūpino khandhā purejātassa imassa kāyassa atthipaccayena paccayo. 6.
patthana2.2:289.1: Arūpī dhammo rūpissa ca arūpissa ca . . . Arūpī eko khandho tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ ca rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo . . . pe . . . dve . . . pe . . . Paṭisandhikkhaṇe . . . pe . . . 7.
patthana2.2:290.1: Rūpī ca arūpī ca dhammā rūpissa . . . Sahajātaṃ, pacchājātaṃ āhāraṃ indriyaṃ. Sahajātā arūpino khandhā ca mahābhūtā ca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā arūpino khandhā ca kabaḷiṃkāro āhāro ca imassa kāyassa atthipaccayena paccayo. Pacchājātā arūpino khandhā ca rūpajīvitindriyañ ca kaṭattā rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. 8.
patthana2.2:291.1: Rūpī ca arūpī ca dhammā arūpissa . . . Sahajātaṃ, purejātaṃ. Sahajāto cakkhuviññāṇasahagato eko khandho ca cakkhāyatanañ ca tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo . . . pe . . . dve . . . pe . . . Kāyaviññāṇasahagato arūpī eko khandho ca vatthu ca tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo . . . pe . . . dve . . . pe . . . Paṭisandhikkhaṇe arūpī eko khandho ca vatthu ca tiṇṇannaṃ khandhānaṃ . . . pe . . . dve . . . pe . . .
patthana2.2:293.1: Hetuyā tīṇi, anantare ekaṃ, ārammaṇe dve, samanantare ekaṃ, adhipatiyā cattāri, sahajāte satta, aññamaññe cha, indriye cha, nissaye satta, jhāne tīṇi, upanissaye dve, magge tīṇi, purejāte ekaṃ, sampayutte ekaṃ, pacchājāte ekaṃ, vippayutte dve, āsevane ekaṃ, atthiyā satta, kamme tīṇi, natthiyā ekaṃ, vipāke tīṇi, vigate ekaṃ, āhāre cattāri, avigate satta:--
patthana2.2:295.1: Rūpī dhammo rūpissa dhammassa sahajātapaccayena paccayo . . . āhāra-, indriya-paccayena paccayo. 2. Rūpī dhammo arūpissa dhammassa ārammaṇa-, . . . sahajāta-, upanissaya-, purejāta-paccayena paccayo. 4. Arūpī dhammo arūpissa dhammassa ārammaṇa-, sahajāta-, upanissaya-, kammapaccayena paccayo. 5. Arūpī dhammo rūpissa dhammassa sahajāta-, pacchājātā-, kammapaccayena paccayo. 6. Arūpī dhammo rūpissa ca arūpicca ca dhammassa sahajāta-, kammapaccayena paccayo. 7. Rūpī ca arūpi ca dhammā rūpissa dhammassa sahajāta-, pacchājāta-, āhāra-, indriyapaccayena paccayo. 8.
patthana2.2:296.1: Rūpī ca arūpī ca dhammā arūpissa dhammassa sahajāta-, purejātapaccayena paccayo.
patthana2.2:302.1: Nahetuyā satta, na-aññamaññe cha, nārammaṇe satta, nanissaye cha, nādhipatiyā satta, na-upanissaye satta, nānantare satta, napurejāte satta . . . nasamanantare satta, (saṃkhittaṃ), . . . nasahajāte cha, namagge satta, nasampayutte cha, nonatthiyā satta, navippayutte pañca, novigate satta, no-atthiyā cattāri, no-avigate cattāri:-- evaṃ gaṇetabbaṃ.
patthana2.2:304.1: Hetupaccayā, nārammaṇe na-upanissaye tīṇi, tīṇi, sabbattha tīṇi; nādhipatiyā tīṇi, nasampayutte ekaṃ, nānantare tīṇi, navippayutte ekaṃ, nasamanantare tīṇi, nonatthiyā tīṇi, na-aññamaññe ekaṃ, novigate tīṇi:--
patthana2.2:306.1: Nahetupaccayā, ārammaṇe dve, adhipatiyā cattāri . . . (anulomamātikā kātabbā) . . . avigate satta.
patthana2.2:308.1: Lokiyaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca lokiyo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Lokiyaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañ ca rūpaṃ, . . . pe . . . dve . . . pe . . . Paṭisandhikkhaṇe khandhe paṭicca vatthu, vatthuṃ paṭicca khandhā; ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ . . . pe . . . mahābhūte paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ kaṭattā rūpaṃ upādā rūpaṃ. 4.
patthana2.2:309.1: Lokuttaraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca lokuttaro dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Lokuttaraṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā . . . pe . . . dve . . . pe . . . 5.
patthana2.2:310.1: Lokuttaraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca lokiyo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Lokuttare khandhe paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. 6.
patthana2.2:311.1: Lokuttaraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca lokiyo ca lokuttaro ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayo. Lokuttaraṃ ekaṃ . . . dve . . . pe . . . 7.
patthana2.2:312.1: Lokiyañ ca lokuttarañ ca dhammaṃ paṭicca lokiyo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Lokuttare khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ . . . (saṃkhittaṃ) . . .
patthana2.2:313.1: Hetuyā pañca, adhipatiyā pañca, ārammaṇe dve, anantare dve, samanantare dve, indriye pañca, sahājāte pañca, jhāne pañca, aññamaññe dve, magge pañca, nissaye pañca, sampayutte dve, upanissaye dve, vippayutte pañca, purejāte dve, atthiyā pañca, āsevane dve, natthiyā dve, kamme pañca, vigate dve, vipāke pañca, avigate pañca.
patthana2.2:315.1: Lokiyaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca lokiyo dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā. Ahetukaṃ lokiyaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paṭicca tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañ ca rūpaṃ . . . pe . . . (ahetukapaṭisandhi yāva asaññasattā). Vicikicchāsahagate uddhaccasahagate khandhe paṭicca vicikicchāsahagato uddhaccasahagato moho . . . (saṃkhittaṃ) . . .
patthana2.2:316.1: Nahetuyā ekaṃ, na-aññamaññe tīṇi, nārammaṇe tīṇi, na-upanissaye tīṇi, nādhipatiyā dve, napurejāte cattāri, nānantare tīṇi, napacchājāte pañca, nasamanantare tīṇi, nāsevane pañca, (nāsevanamulake lokuttare suddhake arūpe vipāko ti niyāmetabbaṃ. Avasesā pakatikā yeva) nakamme dve, na-indriye ekaṃ, navipāke pañca, najhāne ekaṃ, nāhāre ekaṃ, namagge ekaṃ, nasampayutte tīṇi, nonatthiyā tīṇi, navippayutte dve, novigate tīṇi.
patthana2.2:318.1: Hetupaccayā, nārammaṇe tīṇi, nasampayutte tīṇi, nādhipatiyā dve navippayutte dve, (nānantarepadādi paccaniyasadisā) nonatthiyā tīṇi, navipāke pañca, novigate tīṇi.
patthana2.2:320.1: Nahetupaccayā, ārammaṇe ekaṃ, anantare ekaṃ . . . (saṃkhittaṃ) . . . avigate ekaṃ.
patthana2.2:323.1: Lokiyaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā lokiyo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Lokiyaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ paccayā . . . (saṃkhittaṃ) . . . ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ . . . pe . . . mahābhūte paccayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ kaṭattā rūpaṃ upādā rūpaṃ. Vatthuṃ paccayā lokiyā khandhā. 2.
patthana2.2:324.1: Lokiyaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā lokuttaro . . . Vatthuṃ paccayā lokuttarā khandhā. 3.
patthana2.2:325.1: Lokiyaṃ . . . lokiyo ca lokuttaro ca . . . Vatthuṃ paccayā lokuttarā khandhā. Mahābhūte paccayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. 4.
patthana2.2:327.1: Lokiyañ ca lokuttarañ ca dhammaṃ paccayā lokiyo . . . hetupaccayā. Lokuttare khandhe ca mahābhūte ca paccayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. 8.
patthana2.2:328.1: Lokiyañ ca lokuttarañ ca dhammaṃ paccayā lokuttaro dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Lokuttaraṃ ekaṃ khandhañ ca vatthuñ ca paccayā tayo khandhā . . . pe . . . dve.. pe . . . 9.
patthana2.2:329.1: Lokiyañ ca . . . lokiyo ca lokuttaro ca dhammā . . . Lokuttaraṃ ekaṃ khandhañ ca vatthuñ ca paccayā tayo khandhā . . . pe . . . dve . . . pe . . . Lokuttare khandhe ca mahabhūte ca paccayā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ . . . (saṃkhittaṃ).
